info.title: job_ready API
info.description: Hack the Change 2026. Docs: job_ready API Documentation v0.5. Log in with POST /api/v1/auth/login (test accounts from db/test-data.sql, e.g. maya.chen@test.jobready.dev / password123) and use the token as Bearer auth. In local demo mode (app.auth.mode=demo) requests without a token act as the demo user. Every response is wrapped as {code, msg, data}: code 1 = success, 0 = failure (msg has the reason), except GET /resumes/{id}/pdf which returns the raw PDF. Endpoints marked [AI] call Google Gemini.
